scope: Separate early valuation selling from the native valuation state and peak-memory lifecycle, on the REENTRY_BUY benchmark
hypothesis: An independent temporary 30% QQQ cap may retain benefits of earlier selling without resetting valuation memory or removing subsequent native defenses.
reference: Unchanged 2026-10-27 REENTRY_BUY: guarded residual-cash-half reentry plus conditional buy confirmation acceleration
coupled_control: Archived COMBINED from 2026-10-27; verify original input hashes and retain all scenarios as descriptive comparator, not the adoption benchmark

valuation_overlay.entry: After today's native evaluation: defense_mode still WARNING, native pending defense_mode candidate is DEFENSE with >=2 consecutive qualifying sessions, and the existing 20/252-day down-disagreement streak is >=2 sessions. The native candidate enforces original rule priority and does not count the first NORMAL->WARNING session as a WARNING->DEFENSE confirmation.
valuation_overlay.target: min(current native source QQQ target, 0.30), BIL is remainder. Existing lower protection/no-top-up targets win. This retains the native valuation-defense sizing/bands, not a new no-top-up rule for ordinary valuation defense.
valuation_overlay.release: While native WARNING remains, release after recovery_score>=4 and QQQ close>EMA20 for two consecutive sessions. Release immediately when native defense_mode leaves WARNING, including handoff to native DEFENSE or native WARNING resolution to NORMAL. Loss of the entry disagreement alone does not release an active overlay.
valuation_overlay.memory: Never mutate native defense_mode, valuation_peak, valuation_peak update rules, or their pending counters. Native six-session WARNING->DEFENSE and two-session DEFENSE->NORMAL continue independently. The overlay does not set NORMAL upon release.
valuation_overlay.reentry_priority: While the early cap is active, cancel existing Method 1 additions and prohibit new ones. On release only the ordinary weekly entry rule may add risk. All source decisions see actual changed holdings.
valuation_overlay.orders: While active or on release, evaluate final target change and the original 7.5pp deviation/4pp stock-underweight bands against the capped/final target. Ignore source overweight orders caused solely by the cap. Handoff to the same native target does not force a redundant reset. Otherwise delegate unchanged guarded-reentry orders.

trend_sell: Only in MEMORY_TREND/MEMORY_BOTH: retain prior adaptive BEAR confirmation 10->3 under down-disagreement. Do not accelerate native valuation state. All profiles keep prior adaptive buy confirmations.
execution: Unchanged completed-close/next-open and pending-order deadline rules from qqq_adaptive_speed. Fractional shares, adjusted OHLC, commission and slippage included. No extra day for initial allocation under delay stress.

gate.concentration: Report all windows/events; concentration alone is not a rejection criterion
gate.meaning: Historical incremental support; no production deployment or assured future returns

checks: REFERENCE reproduces archived REENTRY_BUY NAV, targets and actual holdings within 1e-12
every profile's native valuation state and peak equals REFERENCE on every date
final target never exceeds a hard-protected native target
no addition during active early selling
original native defense triggers are retained
limitations: All historical periods were previously inspected
The memory-preservation hypothesis was developed after observing the previous failure
Old-crisis CAPE/cash proxies and publication-time limitations unchanged
No parameter sweep, paid data, or live fills
